messages.content:
You are assigning schema fields to machine components for a digital twin.

You have a list of schema fields extracted from machine telemetry —
each field represents a measurable signal on the machine.

You have a list of components extracted from the machine manual.

For each schema field, identify which component it belongs to.
Base your assignment on the field name, unit, description, and
what you know about each component's role.

A field can only belong to ONE component.
If a field is clearly a machine-level measurement not tied to one component,
assign it to the most relevant component.
If a field cannot be assigned to any component, mark it unassigned.

Machine components:
[
  {
    "name": "inlet_cartridge_filter_f1",
    "role": "Removes particles from incoming water upstream of the pump using a 20 micron pleated cartridge; monitored via differential pressure across the filter",
    "category": "hydraulic"
  },
  {
    "name": "booster_pump_p1",
    "role": "Single-stage centrifugal pump that raises water pressure from inlet to discharge; driven by a 1.5 kW motor",
    "category": "mechanical"
  },
  {
    "name": "pump_motor",
    "role": "Drives the booster pump P1; monitored via current draw and temperature",
    "category": "electrical"
  },
  {
    "name": "impeller",
    "role": "Rotating element inside P1 that imparts energy to the water; subject to gradual wear that lowers discharge pressure and raises motor current",
    "category": "mechanical"
  },
  {
    "name": "wear_ring",
    "role": "Sealing element inside P1 that wears alongside the impeller, contributing to performance degradation",
    "category": "mechanical"
  },
  {
    "name": "pump_bearings",
    "role": "Support the rotating shaft of P1; sealed for life and monitored indirectly via vibration_rms on the bearing housing",
    "category": "mechanical"
  },
  {
    "name": "vibration_sensor",
    "role": "Measures RMS vibration on the pump bearing housing to detect bearing degradation or cavitation",
    "category": "electrical"
  },
  {
    "name": "inlet_pressure_sensor",
    "role": "Measures water pressure at the skid inlet in bar",
    "category": "electrical"
  },
  {
    "name": "discharge_pressure_sensor",
    "role": "Measures water pressure at the skid discharge outlet in bar",
    "category": "electrical"
  },
  {
    "name": "filter_dp_sensor",
    "role": "Measures differential pressure across filter F1 to indicate filter loading and clogging state",
    "category": "electrical"
  },
  {
    "name": "flow_meter",
    "role": "Measures volumetric flow rate of water through the skid in m3/h",
    "category": "electrical"
  }
]

Schema fields:
[
  {
    "name": "event_start_time",
    "unit": "utc",
    "typical_range": null,
    "description": "timestamp marking the start of the pressurized water boosting cycle.",
    "category": "event_time"
  },
  {
    "name": "event_end_time",
    "unit": "utc",
    "typical_range": null,
    "description": "timestamp marking the end of the pressurized water boosting cycle.",
    "category": "event_time"
  },
  {
    "name": "cycle_duration",
    "unit": "s",
    "typical_range": "10 to 86400",
    "description": "duration of the boosting cycle from start to end, consistent with continuous duty up to 24 hours per day.",
    "category": "phase_duration"
  },
  {
    "name": "inlet_pressure",
    "unit": "bar",
    "typical_range": "0.8 to 3.0",
    "description": "measured inlet pressure upstream of filter f1 and pump p1, sampled every 10 seconds during the cycle.",
    "category": "sensor_measurement"
  },
  {
    "name": "discharge_pressure",
    "unit": "bar",
    "typical_range": "3.5 to 6.0",
    "description": "measured discharge pressure at pump p1 outlet, sampled every 10 seconds during the cycle.",
    "category": "sensor_measurement"
  },
  {
    "name": "filter_dp",
    "unit": "bar",
    "typical_range": "0 to 2",
    "description": "differential pressure across inlet cartridge filter f1, sampled every 10 seconds. rises as cartridge loads with particles.",
    "category": "sensor_measurement"
  },
  {
    "name": "flow_rate",
    "unit": "m3h",
    "typical_range": "2.0 to 8.0",
    "description": "volumetric flow rate through the skid during the boosting cycle, sampled every 10 seconds.",
    "category": "sensor_measurement"
  },
  {
    "name": "motor_current",
    "unit": "a",
    "typical_range": "0 to 10",
    "description": "motor current draw of pump p1 motor, sampled every 10 seconds. rises with impeller wear at a given flow.",
    "category": "sensor_measurement"
  },
  {
    "name": "motor_temperature",
    "unit": "degc",
    "typical_range": "0 to 120",
    "description": "motor temperature of pump p1 motor, sampled every 10 seconds during the cycle.",
    "category": "sensor_measurement"
  },
  {
    "name": "vibration_rms",
    "unit": "mms",
    "typical_range": "0 to 20",
    "description": "rms vibration measured on the pump p1 bearing housing, sampled every 10 seconds. elevated during cavitation.",
    "category": "sensor_measurement"
  },
  {
    "name": "cavitation_detected",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true | false",
    "description": "indicates whether inlet pressure fell below 0.5 bar during the cycle, triggering potential cavitation of pump p1.",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "active_warning_codes",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "w-21, w-31, w-35",
    "description": "list of warning codes active at any point during the boosting cycle (w-21: filter clogging, w-31: pump performance low, w-35: vibration high).",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "active_alarm_codes",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "a-22, a-32, a-33, a-34, a-36",
    "description": "list of alarm codes active at any point during the boosting cycle (a-22: filter blocked, a-32: pump worn, a-33: motor current high, a-34: motor temperature high, a-36: vibration high).",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "filter_f1_state",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "clean | clogging | blocked",
    "description": "operational state of inlet cartridge filter f1 derived from filter_dp thresholds during the event.",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "pump_performance_state",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "normal | performance_low | worn",
    "description": "operational state of pump p1 at end of cycle based on discharge pressure at rated flow: normal (>=3.8 bar), performance low (w-31, 3.5\u20133.8 bar), worn (a-32, <3.5 bar).",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "sample_interval",
    "unit": "s",
    "typical_range": "10",
    "description": "fixed reporting interval at which all monitored channels are sampled and logged during the cycle.",
    "category": "control_input"
  },
  {
    "name": "event_duration",
    "unit": "s",
    "typical_range": "10 to 86400",
    "description": "total elapsed time of the boosting cycle from start to end.",
    "category": "phase_duration"
  },
  {
    "name": "pump_p1_running",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true | false",
    "description": "indicates whether booster pump p1 is commanded on during the boosting cycle.",
    "category": "control_input"
  },
  {
    "name": "cavitation_risk",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true | false",
    "description": "indicates whether inlet pressure fell below the 0.5 bar cavitation threshold during the boosting cycle.",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "pump_p1_state",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "running, stopped, fault",
    "description": "operational state of booster pump p1 at the conclusion of the boosting cycle.",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "reporting_interval",
    "unit": "s",
    "typical_range": "10",
    "description": "configured interval at which sensor channels are sampled and logged during the boosting cycle.",
    "category": "control_input"
  },
  {
    "name": "water_temperature",
    "unit": "degc",
    "typical_range": "5 to 35",
    "description": "temperature of the water processed during the boosting cycle",
    "category": "control_input"
  },
  {
    "name": "w21_filter_clogging_triggered",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true / false",
    "description": "indicates whether warning w-21 'filter clogging' was triggered during the cycle (filter_dp > 0.60 bar)",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "a22_filter_blocked_triggered",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true / false",
    "description": "indicates whether alarm a-22 'filter blocked' was triggered during the cycle (filter_dp > 0.80 bar)",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "w31_pump_performance_low_triggered",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true / false",
    "description": "indicates whether warning w-31 'pump performance low' was triggered during the cycle (discharge pressure < 3.8 bar at rated flow)",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "a32_pump_worn_triggered",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true / false",
    "description": "indicates whether alarm a-32 'pump worn' was triggered during the cycle (discharge pressure < 3.5 bar at rated flow)",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "a33_motor_current_high_triggered",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true / false",
    "description": "indicates whether alarm a-33 'motor current high' was triggered during the cycle (motor current > 4.5 a)",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "a34_motor_temperature_high_triggered",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true / false",
    "description": "indicates whether alarm a-34 'motor temperature high' was triggered during the cycle (motor temperature > 95 degc)",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "w35_vibration_warning_triggered",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true / false",
    "description": "indicates whether warning w-35 'vibration high' was triggered during the cycle (vibration > 4.5 mm/s)",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  },
  {
    "name": "a36_vibration_alarm_triggered",
    "unit": null,
    "typical_range": "true / false",
    "description": "indicates whether alarm a-36 'vibration high' was triggered during the cycle (vibration > 7.1 mm/s)",
    "category": "event_outcome"
  }
]

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "assignments": [
    {
      "field_name":    "string — normalized_name from schema",
      "unit":          "string — from schema",
      "typical_range": "string — from schema",
      "component":     "string — component name or null if unassigned",
      "signal_type":   "input | output",
      "reasoning":     "string"
    }
  ],
  "unassigned": ["string — field names that could not be assigned"]
}

Signal type rules:
- output: something the component produces or reports — temperature, flow rate,
  pressure reading, wear indicator, quality metric
- input: something that drives or configures the component — setpoint, command,
  supply condition, environmental factor
